rows.name_team: Whitney M. Young Magnet High School
Robert G. Cole High School varsity basketball team

trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE pf.tenure = 'latest' AND ((CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <= 1989 AND p.college = 'University of Connecticut') OR (CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 1 AND t.team_name <> 'Milwaukee Bucks')) RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, p.draft_year AS col2, o.name AS col3, p.name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) AND (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) AND (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) AND (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) AND ((p.college = 'University of Connecticut' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <= 1989) OR (CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 1 AND t.team_name <> 'Milwaukee Bucks')) RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, p.draft_year AS col2, o.name AS col3, p.name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE ((p.college = 'University of Connecticut' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <= 1989) OR (CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 1 AND t.team_name <> 'Milwaukee Bucks')) RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, p.draft_year AS col2, o.name AS col3, p.name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
